CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "__EFMigrationsHistory" (
    "MigrationId" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
    "ProductVersion" character varying(32) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK___EFMigrationsHistory" PRIMARY KEY ("MigrationId")
);

START TRANSACTION;
CREATE TABLE "Issues" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "Severity" integer NOT NULL,
    "Message" text NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_Issues" PRIMARY KEY ("Id")
);

CREATE TABLE "People" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "FirstName" text NOT NULL,
    "LastName" text NOT NULL,
    "Email" text NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_People" PRIMARY KEY ("Id")
);

CREATE TABLE "Projects" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "ReferenceId" integer,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_Projects" PRIMARY KEY ("Id"),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Projects_Projects_ReferenceId" FOREIGN KEY ("ReferenceId") REFERENCES "Projects" ("Id") ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE "Roles" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "DepartmentLeadId" integer NOT NULL,
    "Department" text NOT NULL,
    "Name" text NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_Roles" PRIMARY KEY ("Id"),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Roles_People_DepartmentLeadId" FOREIGN KEY ("DepartmentLeadId") REFERENCES "People" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE "Machines" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "SerialNumber" text NOT NULL,
    "ProjectId" integer NOT NULL,
    "ReferenceId" integer,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_Machines" PRIMARY KEY ("Id"),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Machines_Machines_ReferenceId" FOREIGN KEY ("ReferenceId") REFERENCES "Machines" ("Id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Machines_Projects_ProjectId" FOREIGN KEY ("ProjectId") REFERENCES "Projects" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE "MachineComputerPersons" (
    "ComputerId" integer NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "FK_MachineComputerPersons_People_ComputerId" FOREIGN KEY ("ComputerId") REFERENCES "People" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);
